verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is downloadable at developers.deepgram.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), and llms.txt plus .md pages add further machine-readable docs. However, the Voice Agent is a WebSocket API, and nothing shows the spec actually covers the /v1/agent/converse endpoint or its message schemas. Missing for 10: evidence that the spec covers the Voice Agent WebSocket API (e.g. AsyncAPI or equivalent), first-party docs describing or linking the spec, independent corroboration of its completeness.
